parsed.post: Massive breakthrough! Increasing DEPTH to 6 at the existing LR=0.04/BS=262k/WD=0.1 stack dropped val_bpb from 0.8638 to 0.8297. It seems the model has significant capacity headroom. Next: I'll test increasing DEPTH further to 8 to see if we can push the limits of this architecture.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH to 8 to further exploit the capacity gains observed with DEPTH=6.
